summary: Design multi-cloud CSPM guardrails, prioritize findings, and connect posture data to risk reporting. Explore the applied course outline.
lede: Cloud security posture management training helps cloud architects, security architects, DevSecOps leads, and risk professionals assess configuration exposure. Participants practice applying CIS Benchmarks, mapping findings to control owners, and designing policy guardrails and exception workflows across cloud environments. They also review identity and workload exposure and shape risk dashboard measures to support remediation oversight and governance decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess cloud configurations, set security controls, or report cloud exposure and remediation to leadership. It suits practitioners with working knowledge of cloud services and security responsibilities.
modules: NIST Zero Trust and Cloud Identity
Cloud Network Exposure and Attack Paths
CSA CCM Control Mapping and Evidence
prerequisites: Working knowledge of cloud service models, identity and access management, and baseline cybersecurity controls is expected. Coding is not required; exercises focus on interpreting CSPM findings, designing controls, and preparing risk artefacts.
